body.name: Sharp coarsened-record stationary-response interval
body.construction: For every \(e\in\mathcal O^{T+1}\) with \(\Pr_{P,\rho,b,o}(E_T=e)>0\), define \(I_T(P,\rho,b,o,e)=\{Q_{q,T}(P,\rho,b,o,e):q\in\Theta(P)\}=[\min_{q\in\Theta(P)}Q_{q,T}(P,\rho,b,o,e),\max_{q\in\Theta(P)}Q_{q,T}(P,\rho,b,o,e)]\) and \(D_T(P,\rho,b,o,e)=\max_{q\in\Theta(P)}Q_{q,T}(P,\rho,b,o,e)-\min_{q\in\Theta(P)}Q_{q,T}(P,\rho,b,o,e)\).
